text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — Velora renewal returned signed docs but signer used 'Velora Holdings Ltd (UK)' while billing/PO needs 'Velora, Inc.' Customer procurement is asking for a vendor-code tied to the EU entity. Can we map signer to invoice entity or do we need a new signature?
Dan Li: Ah ok. Do we have the original quote entity set to US or EU? This will affect billing.
Maya Chen: Quote was generated under Velora, Inc. (US). Customer mentioned they have a local procurement team that routed through the EU subsidiary.
Rachel Ortiz: Procurement asked for a PO referencing the exact legal entity on the contract. They're refusing to process the US entity PO without a brief amendment. :confused:
Asha (Legal Ops): If the signed signature block names the UK entity we need either: (1) amendment specifying Velora, Inc. as contracting party, or (2) an assignment addendum + confirmation email from authorized signer. Short of that we can't change invoicing entity.
Tom (Finance): From billing side, we can accept a PO referencing the US entity, but AP will reject if the contract doesn't match. We could provisionally accept a CC payment to avoid churn while legal sorts it.
Maya Chen: Customer prefers to avoid additional paperwork. They're pushing for us to accept the EU PO and invoice the US entity. Not ideal.
esign-bot: Envelope 0x7a2f: signature completed by "S. Powell" on 2026-03-21 09:42 UTC. Status: completed. No additional recipients.
Dan Li: Could we do a short amendment template? One paragraph: "Parties agree that Velora Holdings Ltd shall be an affiliate signing on behalf of Velora, Inc. for the purposes of this agreement." I can draft and send for esign.
Asha (Legal Ops): That language is ok but we need confirmation of authority. Can Maya get an email from the signer's legal rep? If we get that + amendment via e-sign, legal can approve without full re-negotiation.
Maya Chen: I'll request explicit authority email and propose the short amendment. Customer SLA: wants this closed within 48 hrs or they'll delay deployment.
Tom (Finance): If we need a stop-gap, approve temporary CC to clear invoice so implementation isn't blocked. Will need cc authorization on file and receipts.
Rachel Ortiz: Noted. I'll offer the CC fallback option and ask for PO + authority email. If they refuse, escalate to account exec.
Dan Li: Draft amendment here for review:```
Amendment: The Parties acknowledge that Velora Holdings Ltd acted as authorized signatory for Velora, Inc. and agree that the Agreement shall be interpreted to bind Velora, Inc. to the obligations set forth herein.
```
Asha (Legal Ops): Fine with that text if we add signer authority line: "Signed by whom, title, and confirmation of authority." Add a one-line acceptance from Velora legal.
Maya Chen: Sending amendment + authority request now. Will copy legal and finance.
Tom (Finance): Once we have amendment + confirmation, we can process the EU PO mapping to US entity and close. If not, proceed with CC fallback.
esign-bot: Reminder: new envelope created by Maya Chen for amendment. Link: https://esign.example.com/envelope/0x8b9c
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — pinging @Velora procurement for authority email. Will update in-thread when they respond. :pray:
